findings_qualitative.value: Bipolar CO outflows and compact dusty disks/envelopes detected for HH 901/902; N2D+ traces only dense gas coincident with continuum

evidence.quote: Our observations reveal for the first time, the bipolar CO collimated outflows, and the dusty disks (plus envelopes)

claims.hypothesis: HH 901/902 are driven by embedded protostars with compact outflows and disks
claims.experiment: ALMA 1.3 mm continuum and CO line imaging
claims.result: Bipolar CO outflows and 0.1 Msun disk+envelope detected
claims.finding: Driving sources are low- or maybe intermediate-mass Class 0/I protostars

evidence.quote: which suggests that they could be low- or maybe intermediate- mass protostars

claims.experiment: EUV photo-evaporation rate from Tr 14 and pillar masses
